item.title: Best Premium WordPress Themes for Performance and Design
item.description: The community consensus favors lightweight, block-editor-compatible themes like Kadence, Astra, and GeneratePress for modern website development. Based on 7 community reports. Linked sources: 7. Known Issues Over-reliance on heavy page builders Performance degradation with excessive plugins Compatibility issues with older PHP versions Community Q&A What are the best lightweight WordPress themes? Kadence, Astra, and GeneratePress are widely recommended for their speed, flexibility, and excellent integration with the WordPress block editor.

item.title: Best WordPress Themes for Business Websites

item.title: Best Premium WordPress Themes for WooCommerce
item.description: Community consensus favors lightweight, purpose-built themes like Storefront or Rey for WooCommerce performance and stability. Based on 4 community reports. Linked sources: 4. Known Issues Theme bloat affecting site speed Compatibility conflicts with page builders Inconsistent support for AJAX filtering Community Q&A What is the best theme for WooCommerce? Storefront is highly recommended for its native integration, while Rey is favored for complex, high-performance custom projects. Should I use a premium theme or a free theme?

item.title: Best WordPress Portfolio Themes: Recommendations and Tips
item.description: The community recommends using lightweight, block-based themes or the Twentig plugin for a clean, minimal portfolio design. Based on 5 community reports. Linked sources: 5. item.title: Best Lightweight and Fast WordPress Themes for Performance
